meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 DuckDB、Polars、numpy 等引擎直接查询和分析你的 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据,做分组、连接、聚合、时间序列、清洗和绘图,重活会报告行数与耗时。
howto.when: 当你要求分析 CSV、Parquet、JSON 数据集,或要做分组、连接、聚合等操作时触发。

say.text: 用 DuckDB 直接查 data.csv,按城市分组算平均订单金额
say.note: 会先判断放内存还是就地查询

say.text: 这个 parquet 有 2000 万行,看看有没有重复和缺失
say.note: 超出内存会改用流式处理

say.text: 把这份销售数据画成按月趋势图
say.note: 绘图前会按参考文档做视觉检查

howto.what_en: Claude queries and analyzes your CSV, Parquet and JSON data with DuckDB, Polars and numpy — grouping, joins, aggregation, time series, cleaning, plotting — and reports row counts and timing for heavy work.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to analyze a CSV, Parquet or JSON dataset, or to group, join or aggregate data.

say_en.text: Query data.csv with DuckDB and average order value by city
say_en.note: It first decides in-memory vs in-place

say_en.text: This parquet has 20M rows, check duplicates and nulls
say_en.note: Past RAM it switches to streaming

say_en.text: Plot this sales data as a monthly trend chart
say_en.note: It runs a visual check before delivering
